about: Root of Trust test vectors, generated by experiments/root-of-trust/11_vectors.py. Hashes are SHA-256 in hex. Merkle trees follow RFC 9162; subtrees and MTC encodings follow draft-ietf-plants-merkle-tree-certs-07; tiles follow C2SP tlog-tiles; notes follow C2SP signed-note.

merkle.leaves: leaf i is the single byte i, for i = 0 .. 19

appendix_c.leaves: leaf i is the single byte i; every 0 <= start <= end <= 130 (and n <= 130 for C.1.3)

line_formats.C.1.1: [START, END) HASH\n for every valid subtree
line_formats.C.1.2: INDEX [START, END) P1 P2 ...\n for every index of every valid subtree
line_formats.C.1.3: [START, END) N P1 P2 ...\n for every valid subtree of every tree size N

mtc_proof.note: signatures sorted by cosigner ID, shorter first, then bytewise
